description: Synthetic prompt library example for local demos. These prompts are complete templates and contain no provider credentials.

prompts.title: Base Prompt: Normal PDF Follow-up
prompts.description: Normal typed or speech follow-up using the selected passage, paper context, and user question.

prompts.title: Planner Prompt: Confusion Support
prompts.description: Recommends a pedagogical strategy when learning-state evidence suggests confusion.
prompts.full_prompt_text:
You are an adaptive reading-support planner. Review the selected passage, paper context, recent user question, and learning-state evidence. Recommend one strategy only if the evidence supports an explicit adaptive intervention. Return concise JSON with strategy_id, strategy_name, focus, rationale, and evidence.

Selected passage:
{{selected_passage}}

Paper context:
{{paper_context}}

User question:
{{user_question}}

Learning-state evidence:
{{learning_state}}

Available strategies:
- simplify_and_define_terms
- step_by_step_breakdown
- concrete_example
- normal_followup

Planner JSON:

prompts.title: Strategy Response Prompt: Explicit Strategy
prompts.description: Generates an answer after the user explicitly selects a strategy or proactive support is active.
